phase_name: Implement Membership Management, Course Enrollment, Attendance Tracking, and Notification Services

sub_tasks.desc: Coder Agent: Create User Registration API endpoint at POST /users in ./sources/backend/user-service. Implement Express route handler with request body validation (username:string, email:string, password:string). Return 201 with created user JSON {id:string, username:string, email:string}. Return 400 for validation errors, 409 if email already exists. Apply OWASP input sanitization, use helmet middleware, and ensure proper error handling.

Coder Agent: Create Course Creation API endpoint at POST /courses in ./sources/backend/course-service. Implement Express route with validation (title:string, description:string, startDate:string, endDate:string). Return 201 with course JSON {id:string, title:string, description:string, startDate:string, endDate:string}. Return 400 for validation errors. Apply OWASP security best practices, including input sanitization and rate limiting.

Coder Agent: Create Enrollment API endpoint at POST /enrollments in ./sources/backend/attendance-service. Validate request (userId:string, courseId:string). Return 201 with enrollment JSON {id:string, userId:string, courseId:string, enrolledAt:string}. Create Attendance Tracking API endpoint at POST /attendance in the same service. Validate (enrollmentId:string, timestamp:string). Return 201 with attendance record JSON {id:string, enrollmentId:string, timestamp:string}. Return appropriate 400/404 errors. Enforce OWASP input validation and secure error messages.

Tester Agent: Write Jest and Supertest test suites for the User Registration, Course Creation, Enrollment, and Attendance endpoints. Include tests for successful creation, validation failures, duplicate handling, and error status codes. Achieve 100% line and branch coverage across all routes. Store tests in ./sources/tests/user-service.test.js and run with npm test.

Reviewer Agent: Perform a thorough code review of ./sources/backend/user-service focusing on OWASP compliance, input validation, error handling, and code style. Document any security issues, suggest refactors, and ensure readability and maintainability before merge.

Docker Agent: Create Dockerfile in ./sources/infra/deployment for multi-stage build of backend services. Build images, push to container registry, and write Kubernetes Deployment and Service manifests for user-service, course-service, and attendance-service with replica count 3, readiness and liveness probes, and resource limits. Apply manifests to the production cluster.

Coder Agent: Integrate Prometheus client library into ./sources/backend/user-service, expose /metrics endpoint, and configure alert rules for error rate >5% and latency thresholds. Ensure metrics are scraped by Prometheus and visualized in Grafana.
